items.title: Discord's Wumpus gets tortured in fan art over the age-check update
items.summary: Discord tried to joke its way through a buggy age assurance update, which users said was misjudging adults as minors, by posting its mascot Wumpus crying and giving a thumbs-up. People answered with quote posts of ever more elaborate art of Wumpus being tortured. By Sep 25 the biggest had 313K and 273K likes, one user counted 20 "museum-quality" pieces in 48 hours, and Duolingo later joined in.
items.author: @discord

post.name: Discord
post.text: when you launch an extremely popular age assurance update that everyone on Discord was really looking forward to and it has bugs
